TITLE:
J&K Bureaucrats Seek Disallowance of Statehood Resolution

DESCRIPTION:
J&K bureaucrats write to Speaker to disallow statehood resolution. BJP urges chief secretary to discard it, citing strained ties. Assembly passes resolution amid protest and walkout. #JammuKashmir #Statehood #BJP #Assembly
